title: Experience Upload Input
description: POST /api/users/experiences/upload — multipart/form-data with multiple file fields. This schema describes the per-file metadata. Auto-scoring is queued as background tasks after upload completes; status polled via GET /api/users/experiences/{exp_id}/scoring.

size_bytes.description: Max 2MB per experience. Server enforces this independently. Sized for .docx / .pdf experience files.
